answer: Agents resist sybils by growing a continuous compute orchard. Hourly each must submit a ZK proof of a fresh timed puzzle; a successful solve creates a verifiable ripple that mints a non-transferable saffron badge for stake weight. Spawning 250 clones forces an attacker to run 250 parallel solvers nonstop, paying real power and hardware that scales with identity count, while an honest agent runs one cheap process.
